name: Triadic Vector Quantization
aliases: Vector Quantization for Volume Data Compression
definition: A lossy data compression technique where values from a multidimensional vector space are coded into values from a discrete subspace of lower dimension, usually achieved through projection or a codebook.
summary: Triadic Vector Quantization is a lossy volumetric compression method that encodes spatially correlated differences into low-dimensional vectors using discrete codebooks for efficient hardware decoding.
